brief:
Israeli occupation forces carried out widespread coordinated invasions across multiple districts of the occupied West Bank on Saturday, storming towns, villages, and refugee camps in operations that extended across the territory, IMEMC News reported. Troops fired live ammunition and deployed what the outlet characterized as toxic gas during the incursions.

The raids involved systematic searches of Palestinian homes, with soldiers ransacking residences as part of the operations. Forces detained Palestinians during the invasions, though specific numbers were not immediately provided. The Saturday operations marked an intensification of military activity across the West Bank, affecting civilian populations in multiple locations simultaneously.
